Method of Attack: local privilege escalation via bypassing patch for Mobile Device Management Service zero-day
exploitation of incompletely patched vulnerability in 'Access work or school' settings
escalation of arbitrary file disclosure to local privilege escalation
Attack Vector: exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in Mobile Device Management Service
requires system protection enabled on drive C with at least one restore point
requires at least one local administrator account enabled or cached credentials
Indicators of Compromise: public disclosure of zero-day in June 2021
